$comment: The chat clients a project can be set up for, one row each: swcraft init --client and Onboard Project read this file. Paths are relative to the vehicle-architecture template. A row's preselectInHosts names the editor hosts (vscode.env.uriScheme) in which Onboard Project pre-picks it instead of the default; swcraft init has no host and keeps the default. Read by swcraft_tools.agent_clients and by the extension's onboarding (a byte-equal copy among its assets).

conflicts.warning: Copilot also reads .mcp.json, so it may list the SWCraft server twice; see the guide's "Codex and Claude Code in VS Code" section (In VS Code).
Kiro also reads AGENTS.md, so it reads SWCraft's instructions twice, the second time cut short; see the guide's "In Kiro" page.
